messages:
nina: Morning! On my first day I accepted the org invite but private repos still 403. GH says enable SSO + 2FA but I already turned on 2FA. Anyone hit this before?

it-bot: Org policy: SAML SSO + 2FA required. If 2FA was recently enabled you may need to re-authorize the org: https://github.com/orgs/redwood-inference/sso :robot_face: 

sam: Welcome @nina! Quick questions: did you accept with your work email or personal? and is your GH email verified?

nina: accepted with nina@redwood.com and verification shows completed. I clicked the "Authorize" banner but still can't view `team-infra` repo.

ops: There can be a small provisioning delay where SSO shows accepted but team membership hasn't synced. I'll trigger a manual sync for your account. Meanwhile can you run `gh auth status` and `ssh -T git@github.com`?

nina: `gh auth status` -> Logged in as nina@redwood (Session active)
Git operations for github.com: https://github.com/redwood-inference/team-infra (permission: none)

nina: `ssh -T` -> Hi nina! You've successfully authenticated, but GitHub does not provide shell access.

ops: Good SSH auth. I forced the org sync and added you to `team-infra`. Try signing out of the browser and back in, then re-click authorize. If clone still fails use `GIT_SSH_COMMAND="ssh -vvv" git clone ...` and paste logs.

nina: signed out/in, re-authorized, can now view and clone `team-infra`. `git clone git@github.com:redwood-inference/team-infra.git` worked. Thanks!

sam: Great — short checklist for folks: verify email, enable 2FA, add SSH key, sign out/in, click org SSO, wait a minute. Ping #new-hires if it still fails. :thumbsup:

leo: Adding note to onboarding doc about the small sync delay. Welcome aboard @nina!
